fix: k3v6 release-ordering fix (src/PATCHES/k3v6_release_ordering_fix.diff): both consumer-side slot releases (empty_stage after the x^T/z ldmatrix copies, empty_res after the residual ldmatrix) are issued only after every ldmatrix instruction that read the slot has returned its data — one destination register per ldmatrix XOR-ed, warp-reduced (__reduce_or_sync), AND-ed with a run-time zero (%dynamic_smem_size >> 20) and added to the arrive's address, so the SYNCS.ARRIVE carries a true data dependency on the loads (SASS: every LDSM between the slot's PHASECHK and its release is covered by a scoreboard wait, its own or a later in-order LDSM's) — plus fence.proxy.async.shared::cta before the arrive (generic-proxy reads ordered before the async-proxy TMA write the release permits). Arithmetic unchanged: the v6 sealed vectors replay BITWISE with these cubins.

With the fix, the LNFOLD=0 fastsig1 build passed 0/60000 (run 8) and 0/60000 (run 7, dep-lite form) next to 3/60000 and 8/60000 for the unfixed build; it can be built with NVRTC for investigation (face.ALLOW_UNSEALED_LNFOLD0).

register_split_rule: setmaxnreg budgets must satisfy 128*PROD_REGS + 256*CONS_REGS <= 168*384 = 64512 (the CTA's launch allocation), not 65536: CONS 232 / PROD 48 deadlocks in setmaxnreg.inc. PROD_REGS below the producer path's allocated maximum (R26 as built) would be a register-cap violation; keep 232/40.
coverage_rule: every LDSM between a slot's SYNCS.PHASECHK (full wait) and its release SYNCS.ARRIVE is covered before the arrive by a wait-mask on its OWN scoreboard ('own') or on the scoreboard of a LATER LDSM of the same warp ('via_later': shared-memory loads of a warp return in order — the basis on which ptxas itself elides scoreboards of earlier loads). Per site lists below; acceptance of 'via_later' is the reviewer's ruling to make.
